They're stepping back in time to decide whether Douneside House, an Aberdeenshire retreat with a military past, 500-year-old Kilmartin Castle in Argyll and Bute, or The Lovat, a former train station hotel on the shores of Loch Ness, is their favourite.

programme.title: Cumming to the Cabaret
programme.desc: Craft queen Brini helps Michelle create a gorgeous headdress, while comedian Jake gives her a confidence boost on the mic. Then, Daphne, Michelle and Alan team up to construct a classic kissing booth.

programme.title: Cumming to the Cabaret

programme.title: Scotcast
programme.desc: Political analysis with David Wallace Lockhart, Lynsey Bews and Conor Matchett.

programme.title: Rikki
programme.desc: A centenary celebration of the life and legacy of Rikki Fulton, one of Scotland's most beloved comic actors. Ashley Jensen narrates an affectionate tribute to one of Scotland's funniest comedians, Rikki Fulton. It's 100 years since Rikki first made an entrance on to the world stage and 20 years since he bowed out. For decades he's been making the nation laugh with his rubber face, razor sharp wit and laconic demeanour.

programme.title: Still Game

programme.title: Two Doors Down
programme.desc: Party-seeking Cathy and her hen-pecked husband Colin are back from an Italian holiday and excited to be hosting a soirée at their house, arranged for the purpose of showing off how popular they are. They've invited Gail and Andy, the fabulous Amalfi Friends they met in Sorrento, but as the Duty Free wine flows and the guests of honour begin to bond a bit too much with the neighbours, Cathy and Colin's tensions soon bubble to the surface.

programme.title: Rip It Up
programme.desc: A look at the humble beginnings of some of Scotland's biggest-ever bands to show how they evolved, riding the waves of the music industry in order to achieve unprecedented levels of commercial success. Simple Minds grew from the ashes of punk and post-punk, and adopted new technology, the synthesiser, which set them on a course for world pop domination in the 80s.

Featuring interviews with the key figures behind Brighton's rise, alongside celebrity fans who followed every twist along the way, this documentary charts a remarkable journey of survival, ambition and one of the greatest comebacks in modern football.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: From fearless forward to one of English football's most inspirational figures, this is the story of Kevin Keegan. Through triumphs, setbacks and an unwavering passion for the game, we celebrate the life and legacy of a true football icon.
